author: Harry
text:
its because when such an area gets engulfed cleanly, orders remain there that are filled when price returns.

so at ignored supply engulfed north, all the sell orders were consumed
for price to go through and engulf, but not all the buy orders got
filled.

so when price returns from above.. these get filled and you get a bounce

author: sunnytrader1984
text:
Hi LP,

Very nice trade ~^o^~ .

Something I would like to bring to your attention, probably you already know this but still.

On your chart on M15 itself you can clearly find a significant demand
which would have reduced your drawdown to almost NIL, reduced your SL
and increase your Risk:Reward.

Try to find the origin of the moves as deep as you can, and you will be
surprised to see how precisely you can tell when and where you want to
enter and exit.

Good luck.

author: Les_Paul

Sunny, thank you for your comment, I am aware of it. I saw a nice

Lesson learned... Will look for the DP in LTF in future. Thank you!
